test_case.purpose: Verify every required motherboard jumper shunt is present, fully seated and bridges the exact pins/state required by the approved system recipe, without changing configuration during this inspection.
required_package: SUT/MB assembly and PCB revision plus product recipe revision
Complete in-scope jumper designator and expected pins/state/default/exception table
Header pin numbering/orientation references and seating criteria
Safe powered-down chassis/ESD inspection and evidence procedure
test_case.test_command: Bind SUT to motherboard/PCB and recipe revisions; obtain a complete per-designator expected pin-bridge/default/exception table; use powered-down ESD-safe access; qualified operator captures oriented close-ups that show header numbering, shunt seating and actual bridged pins for every entry; compare actual to expected and record missing, loose, extra or mis-set shunts; do not correct within this review step.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Jumper should match with system spec.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact Jumper check identity and as-found evidence to match the signed product/board/SKU specification: `1. Jumper should match with system spec.`. Missing revision, designator, mapping or visual evidence blocks execution; no position change, reseat or actuation is authorized by this inspection.
safety_gate: De-energize/discharge and use ESD controls before inspection
Verify pin-1/orientation and board revision before judging positions
Do not remove, move or reseat shunts under an inspection-only authorization
Stop on ambiguous numbering, loose/damaged hardware or unsafe access
expected_evidence: Oriented indexed close-ups of every actual shunt and seating
test_case.recovery: Any correction/reseat must be a separately authorized action with its own recovery impact; preserve the as-found evidence first.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request jumper settings to match the system specification.

blocked.reason: A safe review-layer method is defined; missing project values are runtime gates rather than a review blocker.
